name: Boss
source: Caerulia's tavern is owned by a strapping and high-spirited man who goes by the name, "Boss". Having built the tavern with his own hands, Boss is awfully proud of the place and will quickly dismiss anyone who has bad things to say about it. Boss may be stern at times, but you'' eventually see him being a part of someone's drunken shenanigans.
